categories.source: Ilyra Fen v666-v4 exact repository seal

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the x1 commit and push had completed; local, upstream, tracking, and fresh live all equalled 9e98b744a8c5b8e7c3d0c37b76fd5d5db347bc8b at zero-zero divergence with a clean worktree
operational_rows.failed_witness: the wrapper yielded only the completed x1 test output before its thirty-second boundary and returned no final commit or equality projection
operational_rows.recovery: inspect repository state read-only with separate exact scalar probes before deciding whether any lifecycle action needs retrying
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: after an ambiguous wrapper boundary, inspect exact state before retrying any commit or remote action
operational_rows.repository_state_changed_by_failed_wrapp: commit and push completed before wrapper output truncation; no duplicate action was attempted
operational_rows.request: commit, push, fetch, and project x1 equality inside one bounded wrapper

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the immutable x1 manifest and tree checks passed inside the x2 suite while all 66 x2 tests passed separately
operational_rows.failed_witness: the x1 lifecycle test correctly expected the current filesystem to contain no x2 directory, but the invocation supplied the later x2 materialization and produced one failure among 77 tests
operational_rows.recovery: leave the committed x1 test unchanged, prove x1 through its exact manifest and zero-later-path Git tree, and run the 66 x2 tests only in the x2 lifecycle domain
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: bind lifecycle-sensitive tests to their declared immutable tree or record an exact lifecycle exclusion; do not weaken a frozen x1 assertion to accommodate x2 materialization
operational_rows.request: run immutable x1 and materialized x2 unit-test modules together from the later x2 worktree

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the later corrected patch used one update operation for the x2 builder and one for the x2 test
operational_rows.failed_witness: the patch tool rejected the duplicate-target operation before changing any repository file
operational_rows.recovery: combine all hunks for each target into one file-update operation
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: emit at most one update operation per target file in a single patch
operational_rows.request: update the x2 operational ledger using one patch that declared two update operations for the same file

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the corrected literal-context patch updated only the reviewed x2 builder and test
operational_rows.failed_witness: the patch tool could not find the incomplete expected line and rejected the whole patch before changing any repository file
operational_rows.recovery: inspect the exact current line and patch it with complete literal context
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: inspect exact current context after any patch verification failure before retrying
operational_rows.request: reapply the combined ledger patch using a report-line context that omitted its leading sentence

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the index contained only reviewed Auren evidence paths while neither staged-review nor evidence-manifest file existed before the separate review invocation
operational_rows.failed_witness: staging completed but the wrapper boundary returned only line-ending warnings before staged review began, so it established no review or manifest result
operational_rows.recovery: inspect the index and validation paths read-only, retain the completed intended staging, then run exact staged review as a separate bounded command after ledger reconciliation
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: separate high-volume first staging from exact staged-review and stat projection on Windows
operational_rows.repository_state_changed_by_failed_wrapp: the intended exact Auren evidence paths were staged; no commit, remote action, review, or manifest was created
operational_rows.request: stage the complete evidence delta, run exact staged review, and project its stat inside one thirty-second wrapper

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the exact report, operational-overlay, evidence-builder, and test contexts were returned without mutation
operational_rows.failed_witness: PowerShell parsed an unescaped alternation segment as a module name and rejected the read-only projection
operational_rows.recovery: use literal line reads and Select-String pattern arrays without shell-significant alternation
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: avoid shell-significant alternation in interpolated PowerShell command strings; use literal pattern arrays
operational_rows.request: inspect several literal builder patterns through one PowerShell ripgrep expression

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the prior review and manifest were present in the index before the optimized attributable rebuild, so no duplicate commit or remote action occurred
operational_rows.failed_witness: the per-path Git subprocess implementation completed and staged both review artifacts but crossed the wrapper boundary and returned no attributable direct result
operational_rows.recovery: inspect the two exact staged paths read-only, replace per-path Git calls with one staged-index map and an alternating exact-length cat-file batch stream, then rebuild the review and manifest
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: use one index enumeration and one alternating exact-length batch blob reader for multi-file staged review
operational_rows.repository_state_changed_by_failed_wrapp: the intended staged review and manifest files were created in the index; no commit or remote action occurred
operational_rows.request: run evidence staged review, manifest construction, diff check, and summary projection inside one thirty-second wrapper

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the corrected review reports the full post-commit owner-file total while remaining far below the 2000-file ceiling
operational_rows.failed_witness: the valid cap check reported 186 because it counted immutable x1 and reviewed content but omitted the two staged self-excluded review and manifest files; the actual bounded total was 188
operational_rows.recovery: add the two declared self-excluded files to the exact owner-tree projection and rebuild the review and manifest
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: include declared self-exclusions in post-commit file-budget projections even when they are excluded from content review recursion
operational_rows.repository_state_changed_by_failed_wrapp: none beyond the already staged review candidate
operational_rows.request: reconcile the optimized staged review's displayed owner-file count against its self-exclusions

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: a corrected scalar-assignment probe found all three intended closeout files, and Python byte-compilation then succeeded for each file
operational_rows.failed_witness: PowerShell rejected the read-only foreach projection because the direct trailing pipeline produced an empty pipe element parser error
operational_rows.recovery: assign the foreach results to an explicit scalar array before piping them to Format-Table, then compile the exact three Python files separately
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: materialize PowerShell foreach output in an explicit variable before applying a trailing pipeline
operational_rows.request: inspect existence, length, line count, and repository status for the three closeout patch files in one read-only PowerShell projection

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: the immutable evidence manifest and evidence Git tree bind the frozen evidence lifecycle while the final-lifecycle composite selects only the nine evidence tests whose preconditions remain valid after closeout materialization
operational_rows.failed_witness: the pre-final 88-test composite produced one failure because the immutable evidence lifecycle test correctly requires closeout, final, and handoff paths to be absent, while those later paths were materialized in the final worktree
operational_rows.recovery: leave the immutable evidence test unchanged, retain the failed composite at zero credit, and exclude only that exact lifecycle-sensitive test from the final-worktree composite
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: bind absence assertions to their immutable lifecycle tree or declare an exact lifecycle exclusion before composing tests in a later materialized worktree
operational_rows.request: run all 66 x2 tests, all 10 immutable evidence tests, and all 12 closeout tests together from the materialized final worktree

operational_rows.bounded_passing_witness: smaller exact-context patches preserve the intended lifecycle correction and cumulative ledger without modifying immutable evidence
operational_rows.failed_witness: the patch tool rejected the combined lifecycle-and-ledger update because one context block did not match the current file ordering
operational_rows.recovery: inspect the exact current contexts and apply smaller target-specific patches
operational_rows.recurrence_guard: split large multi-region corrections after generated content has shifted line ordering
operational_rows.request: apply the evidence-lifecycle correction and cumulative ledger changes across the closeout builder, tests, and canonical runner in one combined patch
